description: Start generating an AI video ad. Provide a template ID and product data (URL to scrape OR direct product info). Returns a video ID for polling. Costs tokens. Generation typically takes 3-8 minutes — call get_video_status with wait:true to receive live progress, or poll no more than once per 60 seconds.

captionStyle.description: Visual style for on-video subtitles. Omit for a random pick at render time.

ctaStyle.description: End-card visual style. classic = green LINK BELOW pill, blurred-photo = first creative blurred behind minimal text, dark-solid = solid dark backdrop with minimal text. Omit for a random pick at render time.

imagePromptHint.description: Free-text hint to steer the look of AI-generated product creatives — e.g. 'product on rocky beach at sunset', 'minimalist tabletop with marble surface'. Layered on top of imageStyle.

imageStyle.description: Lighting/colour preset for AI-generated product creatives. Omit for random.

language.description: Language code: en, es, fr, de, ru, etc.

musicPromptHint.description: Free-text hint for the music generator — e.g. 'epic cinematic trailer at 110 bpm', 'lo-fi beats with vinyl crackle'. Layered on top of musicStyle.

musicStyle.description: Background music style. Omit for a random pick at render time.

productImages.description: Product image URLs (use upload_image first if you have raw bytes)

productUrl.description: Product page URL to scrape (provide this OR product fields)

script.description: Custom voiceover script. If omitted, AI generates one.

videoPromptHint.description: Free-text hint to steer the look of AI-generated product video clips. Only used by templates with a product video step.

voiceId.description: ElevenLabs voice ID. If omitted, uses avatar default.

name: create_video
